title: Sardar
desc: Son of a disgraced spy, Inspector Vijay Prakash must race against the clock to stop a mysterious water company from producing and spreading toxic water across the nation.

title: Gangster
desc: Akbar, a powerful man of Mangalore underworld, shares his business lead with Mani Menon and Uncle Sam. They share a good relationship until Anto, grandson of Uncle Sam, creates havoc.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
desc: Rocky, a young man, seeks power and wealth in order to fulfil a promise to his dying mother. His quest takes him to Mumbai, where he gets involved with the notorious gold mafia.

title: Kuruvi
desc: Vitrivel becomes caught in a web of crime and violence when he tracks down a man who holds his father as bonded labour along with many innocent people.

title: Aadikeshava
desc: Following the death of his biological father, a man travels to Rayalaseema to protect his sister and his ancestral temple.
